### Types

The types the tables below name, from `invitation/domain.ts`:

```ts
type InvitationStatus = "none" | "open" | "accepted" | "declined" | "revoked";

interface InvitedGroup { group: string; scope?: { type: string; id: string } | null }
```

### Commands

Secret fields leave the vault once the command completes; personal fields stay in the vault until their subject is erased.

| Command | Fields | Writes | Who may send it | Refused with |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CreateInvitation`<br>on `invitation` | `email: string`<br>`groups?: InvitedGroup[]`<br>`owner?: boolean` | `InvitationCreated` | a group permission; only with permissions the sender holds | `exists`, `invalid_email`, `invalid_groups`; requires: group.group is active |
| `ResendInvitation`<br>on `invitation` | — | `InvitationResent` | a group permission | `invalid_state` |
| `RevokeInvitation`<br>on `invitation` | — | `InvitationRevoked` | a group permission | `invalid_state` |
| `DeclineInvitation`<br>on `invitation` | `token: string` (secret) | `InvitationDeclined` | anyone (the request carries its proof) | `expired_token`, `invalid_token` |
| `AcceptInvitation`<br>on `invitation` | `token: string` (secret)<br>`accountId: string`<br>`email: string`<br>`newAccount: boolean` | `InvitationAccepted` | the API (its `api` group) | `expired_token`, `invalid_account`, `invalid_token`, `wrong_email` |
| `RecordInvitationMailSent`<br>on `invitation` | `tokenId: string` | `InvitationMailSent` | only the kit's reactors | — |
| `EraseInvitation`<br>on `invitation` | — | `InvitationRevoked`, `InvitationErased` | the platform | `not_found` |

### Events

| Event | Fields | Vault | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `InvitationCreated` | `email: string \| null`<br>`groups: InvitedGroup[]`<br>`owner: boolean`<br>`tokenId: string`<br>`token: string \| null`<br>`expiresAt: number` | `email` under `invitation:<id>`; `token` under `token:<tokenId>` | The email belongs to the invitation (its own subject); the token sits in the vault until used. |
| `InvitationResent` | `previousTokenId: string`<br>`tokenId: string`<br>`token: string \| null`<br>`expiresAt: number` | `token` under `token:<tokenId>`; erases `token:<previousTokenId>` | A new token; erases the old one. |
| `InvitationRevoked` | `tokenId: string` | erases `usedToken` | — |
| `InvitationDeclined` | `tokenId: string` | erases `usedToken` | — |
| `InvitationAccepted` | `tokenId: string`<br>`accountId: string`<br>`newAccount: boolean`<br>`groups: InvitedGroup[]`<br>`owner: boolean` | erases `usedToken` | The identity reactor creates the identity with these groups (and the owner) from it. |
| `InvitationMailSent` | `tokenId: string` | — | — |
| `InvitationErased` | — | erases `invitation:<id>` | Erases the invited email: when the tenant is deleted, or the person asks. |
